cases.input: A unit changes its name without changing purpose or placement.
cases.expect: The unit identity persists and a dated name assertion changes.

cases.input: A future administrative placement is approved with a later effective date.
cases.expect: Current and future intervals remain distinct; as-of replay retains the old placement.

cases.input: A unit has administrative and functional parents at the same instant.
cases.expect: Both placements are valid because their axes are distinct and separately acyclic.

cases.input: A cross-department product team is forced under one administrative parent solely for chart rendering.
cases.expect: The placement is rejected; the team remains a collective with affiliations.

cases.input: A hypothetical placement appears in the asserted-current hierarchy before adoption.
cases.expect: The authoritative projection rejects the branch.

cases.input: Administrative placement is used to infer the worker's employing legal entity.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; employment remains externally mastered.
